name: supa_crawl_knowledge
description: Search and inspect the persistent Supa-Crawl-Chat knowledge base (Supabase/pgvector). Use for semantic search over already-crawled sites, listing indexed sites, crawl status, stored pages/chunks, and corpus health. Complements crawl_url (live pages) and brave_search_llm_context (web). This tool only calls read-only HTTP APIs. Does not start crawls or mutate data.

action.description: Operation: search (default), list_sites, site (metadata for one site), site_status, site_pages, page, page_chunks (GET /api/pages/{page_id}/chunks — all chunk rows for that page), health (corpus stats), crawl_activity (all sites + job summary).

threshold.description: Similarity threshold for semantic search, 0-1. Lower broadens results. Default 0.3.

limit.description: Max results: search up to 100; list_sites cap of sites returned up to 100; site_pages up to 1000.

text_only.description: For action=search, keyword/text search instead of embeddings.

site_id.description: Filter search by site, or required for site/site_status/site_pages.

site_name.description: For action=search: optional site name or URL substring filter (API query param site_name).

after.description: For action=search: ISO datetime; only results with crawled_at after this when metadata exists.

include_search_content.description: For action=search: include full body per hit (larger). When false, results include content_preview (leading markdown) instead.

search_preview_chars.description: For action=search when include_search_content=false only: API preview_chars for content_preview (leading markdown, 0–5000). For longer inline snippets without full body, raise this (e.g. 1000). When include_search_content=true, use search_content_chars instead—preview_chars is not the main control.

search_content_chars.description: For action=search when include_search_content=true: max characters of full content per hit (default 10K, max 20000).

dedupe.description: For action=search: one best hit per source URL (API default true).

page_id.description: Required for page or page_chunks. action=page always works for that row's stored body. action=page_chunks lists child chunk rows for a parent page—if search returns a chunk hit (is_chunk true), use parent_id as page_id for page_chunks, not the chunk row's id (chunk rows often return 0 children).

include_chunks.description: For list_sites/site_pages, include chunk rows in listing.

include_pages_content.description: For site_pages: include full page body in list (larger). When false, each row has content_preview (leading markdown) without loading full bodies.

pages_preview_chars.description: For site_pages when include_pages_content=false: API preview_chars for content_preview (0–5000, default 500).

pages_list_content_chars.description: For site_pages with include_pages_content=true: max characters per listed page body (same role as search_content_chars for search full mode; API default 10K, max 20000).

content_chars.description: For page/page_chunks: max content characters per item. Default 8000 for page, 4000 for chunks. Max 20000.
